list: Official 55-trophy list, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation; 0 online trophies
listSource: Official PlayStation list as published in the kit starter (names, descriptions and grades checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on all 55)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No online play and no DLC are needed; everything is single-player. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% Completion checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and the last miscellaneous trophies.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as part of the story and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy that pops automatically as you move into Chapter 2; it cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy that pops automatically as you move into Chapter 3; it cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy that pops automatically as you move into Chapter 4; it cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy that pops automatically as you move into Chapter 5; it cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It pops automatically and cannot be missed; after it you keep free-roam of Leonida for all the cleanup work.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. A story trophy that pops automatically and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy that pops automatically and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy that pops automatically and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy that pops automatically and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy that pops automatically and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy that pops automatically and cannot be missed.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story and work the checklist. It is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and 70 of 80 challenges, plus all robberies, drone races, shooting ranges and Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories and pick what is quickest — under-the-bridge runs are the fastest. Track progress by region in Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress, Activities to see which types you have done; most come naturally from the story and the other trophies.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx maps every range and its challenges; the golds are forgiving, and practising here also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). PowerPyx lists all 14 spots; a win at each location is what counts, not every single race.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx maps. Any race type counts; each location only counts once, so spread your wins around instead of repeating one favourite.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, he later sends a text marking a fishing challenge west of Key Lento. Go to the purple marker and beat him at fishing.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of a game; its bonus challenges are not required.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline — Lucia only. In Chapter 3 Lucia gets a call from Andy, who texts her home address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests: the Cellerica chain (Climbing the Cellerichain parts 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass). The line stays available after the story.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the Island Dreams mission he calls and is marked KR in Key Lento. Find the treasures he marks (purple chest icons) with the metal detector and bring them back — 7 shipwrecks in total. He goes quiet for a while in later chapters but returns, so nothing here is missable.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain lines count — not Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more are still being found, and all remain available after the story. Track the count in the trophy list.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs you get the Key Cloner and deliver a Zorrusso to Randy; he then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, steal them and drive them to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Delivering them in good condition pays more.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This to shut the labs down. Still available after the story.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, tracked in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice. Do the Chapter 1 meditation while you can: after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept — it is the one meditation that can be missed, and it is still unclear whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. You need both characters together (from Chapter 2's Coffee Break) for the last spots; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Jason gets a text from Bret marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason only). Do that first quest, then follow the purple hunting markers and bring Bret the animals he asks for, using the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle he gives you. PowerPyx notes the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work through Bret's line and its 15 Target Decks — they are also needed for 100%.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets from the 18 sets PowerPyx maps across Leonida. Cards are found in the world; you do not need every set, just three finished ones.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations: hold Up, then R1, on anything scannable. There are more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more — so scan whatever you pass. It overlaps with the vehicle scanning you do for 100% anyway.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. Track them in Progress, Challenges and pick the easiest ones left once the natural ones are done.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, lose a 4-star wanted level. You can only do this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle). Cause chaos to reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy route, as police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back to back without losing your wanted level — keep the flashing red and blue wanted level the whole time, never dropping it or hitting full heat. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) unlocks them; loot a couple of items in each, and the trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — just stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models scanned, so this comes naturally.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming). Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower, and take Adrenaline to stretch the slow-time window. Line up 5 enemies — gang-operation criminals work; it does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians — and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 with body armor on. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at level 4 this is far easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — the one at terminals E3 and E4 is easiest; drive through a fence to reach it, go up the stairs by the boarding bridge and into the cockpit. Reverse to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (never kick it), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash (bring your partner to carry a second bag). After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 once you have done his earlier jobs. Each robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then swap vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… counts as one — tailing the truck to the bank is a vault robbery. Or do it earlier: block a truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx's unfogging guide names the best plane for the job.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, though the 100% checklist needs all 39. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked from story progress; track each gang in Progress, Gangs.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar with the view. That is the whole trophy.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III — and the trophy pops a moment after you are out on the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway — blow it with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab what is left.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength). Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between them. Buy a fitness-club membership and always work out together — call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle) and the partner trains automatically while you work out, doubling progress. Clubs are all over Vice City; filter the map by Activities.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — robberies, stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) to see the demon-face icon each time one registers, and check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. It builds passively; if it is your last trophy, robberies are the fastest way to top it up.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store; come back and rob the same store again as Lucia, alone, on foot. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, aim at the teller, deal with security, break through and empty the 3 cash drawers, then run away on foot until you are clear of the search area — driving away does not count.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. After 2 AM, alone, go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO, approach it, and when it drops the woman it abducted, talk to her, offer to help and go back to her car at the roadside.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City and Ocean Beach make it quick.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across robberies, and a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest and fastest; clothing, footwear, hair and electronics all count too.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 in total) through the Vice City Real Estate app, which arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages do not count. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to fund them.

sources.name: PushSquare — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; early on he only takes cars without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
